sections.description:
aDirectory makes creating a directory or listing website easy and enjoyable. Whether you’re building a business directory, property listing, restaurant guide or hotel directory, this plugin has everything you need.

⚡Addons | ⚡Themes | 📒Documentation | 🛤️Roadmap | 💬Support

You can create multiple directories and customize them with unlimited custom fields. This means you can design your listings exactly how you want. Users can submit their listings from the frontend which makes the process smooth and hassle-free.

It supports OpenStreetMap for location details and offers a modern user dashboard where users can manage their listings effortlessly.

aDirectory enhances the browsing experience with options like grid and list views, price range filters, rating filters, and even a wishlist feature. It includes tools like an image gallery slider, author details, agent contact forms, and social sharing to make your directory site engaging.

Payments are simple with built-in support for PayPal and offline options. The plugin also offers premium features like Stripe payments, listing badges, business hours, and pricing plans for those who want advanced functionalities.

With aDirectory, you get a fully responsive and user-friendly plugin that helps you create professional directory sites without the stress. It’s built for everyone, from beginners to experts, and gives you the tools to make your site stand out.

Helpful Resources of aDirectory WordPress Business Directory Plugin

  • Addons

  • Roadmap
  • Support

Free Features of the Ultimate WordPress Business Directory Plugin – aDirectory

  • Multi-Directory Support : Create and manage multiple directories on the same site for ultimate flexibility.

  • Unlimited Custom Fields : Add as many custom fields as you need to match your directory’s unique requirements.

  • Frontend Listing Submission : Allow users to submit listings directly from the frontend, simplifying the submission process.

  • OpenStreetMap Integration : Display detailed maps and locations without additional costs.

  • User Login & Registration : Enable users to register and log in effortlessly for a personalized experience.

  • User Dashboard : Provide a dedicated space for users to manage their submissions and profiles.

  • Price Range & Ratings Filters : Help visitors find exactly what they need with advanced filtering options.

  • Favorites/Wishlist : Let users save their favorite listings for quick access later.

  • Listing Views (Grid & List) : Display listings in a grid or list layout, depending on your preference.

  • Author Details : Highlight listing authors with their profiles for added credibility.

  • Gallery with Slider : Showcase listings with stunning image galleries and sliders.

  • Agents Contact Form : Make it easy for users to connect with agents directly.

  • Listing Categories & Locations : Organize listings by categories and locations for better navigation.

  • Default Preview Image : Display placeholder images for listings without photos.

  • Video Integration : Embed YouTube or Vimeo videos into your listings to enhance engagement.

  • Elementor Widget Ready : Customize your site easily using Elementor widgets.

  • Social Sharing Options : Let users share listings on their social media platforms effortlessly.

  • Import & Export : Quickly import or export listings to and from your directory.

  • Responsive Layout : Ensure a flawless browsing experience on all devices.

  • Email Notification : Stay informed with instant updates and alerts delivered directly to your inbox.

Premium Features of aDirectory WordPress Business Listing Plugin

Upgrade your directory with aDirectory’s premium features that bring advanced functionality and monetization options:

  • Stripe Payment Gateway (PRO): Accept secure, fast, and seamless payments with Stripe. Enable multiple payment methods like credit cards and wallets to make transactions smooth and reliable for your users.

  • Compare Listing (PRO): Let users compare multiple listings side by side. This feature helps them evaluate details, features, and prices at a glance to enhance user satisfaction.

  • Pricing Plan (PRO): Monetize your directory with customizable pricing plans. Offer tiered packages to suit various user needs, from free to premium options, and generate revenue with ease.

  • Listing Badges (PRO): Highlight special or featured listings with badges. Make top-rated, premium, or newly added listings stand out and increase their visibility.

  • Business Hours (PRO): Display operational hours for businesses listed in your directory. Keep visitors informed about when services are available to ensure a better user experience.

  • Mailchimp Integration (PRO): Connect your directory to Mailchimp for email marketing. Effortlessly collect and manage subscriber data to run targeted campaigns and keep users engaged.

These premium features provide everything you need to build a professional, profitable, and user-friendly directory site. With aDirectory PRO, scaling your business directory is simple and efficient!

aDirectory Premium Addons for Your Classified Ads Listing Website

  1. Compare Listing Addon
    Allow users to compare multiple listings side by side. This feature simplifies decision-making by letting visitors evaluate features, prices, and details of listings simultaneously for better choices.

  2. Badges Addon
    Make premium or special listings stand out with visually appealing badges. Highlight top-rated, featured, or exclusive offers to capture attention and boost visibility.

  3. Pricing Package Addon
    Monetize your directory with flexible pricing plans. This add-on lets you create customized packages to cater to diverse user needs while generating consistent revenue.

  4. Stripe Payment Gateway Addon
    Provide secure and seamless payment processing with Stripe. Support multiple payment methods and ensure faster, more reliable transactions with automatic listing approvals.

  5. Business Hour Addon
    Display operational hours for businesses with ease. Help users know when services are available, offering clarity and enhancing user satisfaction.

  6. Verification Badge Addon
    Build trust by adding verified badges for authenticated listings. This add-on ensures users can easily identify reliable and credible businesses on your directory.

  7. aDirectory Coupon Addon
    Offer and manage discount codes to attract users with promotional deals. Track coupon usage and optimize marketing strategies to boost customer engagement.

  8. WooCommerce Pricing Package Addon
    Seamlessly integrate your directory with WooCommerce to manage and sell pricing packages directly. This add-on combines the power of aDirectory with the flexibility of WooCommerce.

  9. Social Login Addon
    Enable visitors to log in or register using their social media accounts. This feature simplifies the sign-up process and encourages more user registrations.

  10. Mailchimp Integration Addon
    Connect your directory with Mailchimp to manage and grow your email list. Easily collect subscriber data and run targeted campaigns to keep your audience engaged.

Each addon enhances the functionality of your directory to make it easier to scale, monetize, and deliver a top-notch user experience. With these premium tools, aDirectory adapts to meet the demands of modern directory websites.

aDirectory is the ideal solution for anyone looking to create a powerful, easy-to-manage directory website. Whether you want to build a business directory, property listings, or a local service directory, aDirectory provides all the tools you need to get started quickly and grow your site with ease.

Here’s why you should choose aDirectory:

  1. User-Friendly Setup
    Setting up your directory site with aDirectory is simple. The plugin is designed with ease of use in mind, allowing you to create, manage, and display listings without the need for coding or technical expertise.

  2. Flexible Features
    With aDirectory, you can create multiple directories, add unlimited custom fields, and enable frontend listing submissions. You can also integrate essential tools like OpenStreet Map and social sharing options to provide a smooth user experience.

  3. Customization Options
    The plugin gives you complete control over your site’s look and functionality. You can customize listings with gallery sliders, add filters like price range and ratings, and choose between grid or list views.

  4. Monetization Tools
    aDirectory includes powerful monetization features, including multiple payment gateways (PayPal, Stripe) and the ability to create pricing packages. You can generate revenue by offering paid listings or subscription plans.

  5. Scalable and Extensible
    aDirectory grows with your needs. Add premium add-ons like Compare Listings, Business Hours, and Mailchimp Integration to enhance your directory and provide more value to users.

  6. Mobile-Responsive Design

  7. Dedicated Support
    With aDirectory, you get access to reliable support. They will make your life easy by providing 24/7 professional support.

aDirectory is a versatile, feature-rich plugin that offers everything you need to create a fully functional and professional directory site. It’s the perfect choice for entrepreneurs, businesses, and developers looking to build a high-quality directory site.

Privacy Policy

aDirectory – Directory Listing WordPress Plugin uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.

For more details, support, and documentation, please visit adirectory.io.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.
e.g.
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/adirectory directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
3. From Dashboard goto aDirectory -> Settings & Builders for configuration.
sections.faq:
Does aDirectory allow frontend listing submission?

Yes, aDirectory allows users to submit listings directly from the front end of your site. This makes it easy for anyone to add content.

Is submitting a listing free with aDirectory?

You can offer free submissions for listings with aDirectory. You also have the option to monetize the site by offering paid listing options through the Pricing Plan feature in the premium version.

Can I allow users to renew their listings?

Yes, you can enable listing renewals with aDirectory. This gives users the option to keep their listings active.

Does aDirectory support custom fields?

Yes, aDirectory allows you to add unlimited custom fields to listings. This feature helps you collect specific data based on the type of directory you are running.

Does aDirectory support nested categories for listings?

Yes, aDirectory allows you to create nested categories. This makes it easier to organize your listings in a structured way.

Are listings auto-approved in aDirectory?

By default, listings in aDirectory are not auto-approved. Admin will review the listing & approved.

Does aDirectory send email notifications to the admin?

Yes, aDirectory sends email notifications to the admin when new listings are submitted, updated, or deleted.

Can I change the email notification text in aDirectory?

Yes, aDirectory allows you to customize the text for all email notifications sent from the plugin.
